name: CIOMP isomorphic
full_name: CIOMP leader-follower isomorphic vascular interventional surgical robot
group: Changchun Institute of Optics, Fine Mechanics and Physics, CAS, State Key Laboratory of Dynamic Optical Imaging and Measurement (Pengfei Chen, Yutang Wang, Dapeng Tian)
devices_driven: catheter and guidewire (catheter delivery mechanism, catheter rotation mechanism, guidewire operation mechanism; chen2025_design Fig. 1 labels)
n_dof_detail: N.R. (catheter delivery + rotation, guidewire delivery + rotation shown)
translation_detail: other: catheter between upper and lower pressing plates with an electric clamp; guidewire via operating handle on a screw drive (Fig. 1 labels)
rotation_detail: gear drive (driving/driven gears, rotating motor; Fig. 1 labels)
force_sensing: N.R. in abstract; force channels in the four-channel bilateral controller (Fig. 2)
haptics_leader: isomorphic leader with identical structure; four-channel acceleration-based bilateral control with DOB/RFOB (abstract, Fig. 2)
validation_detail: intervention task in a human vascular model with 4 volunteers; CUSUM learning curves (chen2025_design abstract, Fig. 7)
key_numbers: leader-follower delivery error < 1 mm, guidewire rotation error < 0.3 deg; operators mastered the task within 10 trials; operator-experience classification accuracy 94% (chen2025_design abstract)
